boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-admission activities and public destinations in Boston and nearby Cambridge.

cards.title: Browse the Harvard Art Museums
cards.subtitle: 32 Quincy Street, Cambridge
cards.notes: Meet in the galleries and choose a few works to discuss afterward. General admission is free; confirm the day’s visitor hours before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A free public art-museum visit in Harvard Square.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard states that the Harvard Art Museums are free and open to all visitors Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Free Tuesday–Sunday; check the museum’s visitor information for holiday closures and current hours.

cards.title: See historic scientific instruments
cards.subtitle: Harvard Museums of Science & Culture, Cambridge
cards.notes: Plan a short gallery visit around early scientific tools and devices. The collection lists free general admission and its own visiting window.
cards.short_summary: A compact, no-cost collection visit centered on science history.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard Museums of Science & Culture lists general admission to the Collection of Historical Scientific Instruments as free.
cards.source_title: Visit All Four Harvard Museums of Science & Culture
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Sunday–Friday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; verify before travel.

cards.entity_name: Harvard Museum of the Ancient Near East
cards.title: Explore the Ancient Near East galleries
cards.subtitle: Harvard Museums of Science & Culture, Cambridge
cards.notes: Visit with a friend and compare objects or exhibits that catch your attention. The museum’s official visitor page lists general admission as free.
cards.short_summary: Free public galleries focused on the ancient Near East.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard Museums of Science & Culture lists general admission to the Harvard Museum of the Ancient Near East as free.
cards.source_title: Visit All Four Harvard Museums of Science & Culture
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Sunday–Friday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; verify before travel.

cards.title: Walk the Arnold Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Jamaica Plain
cards.notes: Pick a loop, pause at labeled plants, and bring water for a relaxed outdoor walk. Harvard identifies the landscape as open daily and free to explore.
cards.short_summary: A 281-acre living collection for an unhurried walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard says the 281-acre Arnold Arboretum is open daily and free for all to explore.
cards.access_notes: Open daily and free to explore, according to Harvard; use the Arboretum’s current visitor guidance for route details.

cards.title: Take a Franklin Park walk
cards.subtitle: Dorchester, Roxbury, and Jamaica Plain
cards.notes: Choose a daytime walking route and use the landscape as a setting for a catch-up. The City identifies the park as free, open to the public, and accessible.
cards.short_summary: A large public landscape within Boston’s Emerald Necklace.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston states that Franklin Park is free, open to the public, and accessible.
cards.source_title: Franklin Park as the People’s Park | Boston.gov
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor park; plan for daylight and follow posted park rules.

cards.entity_name: DCR Free Friday Flicks at Hatch Memorial Shell
cards.title: Watch a free Friday Flick
cards.subtitle: Hatch Memorial Shell, Charles River Esplanade
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or seat and catch the scheduled outdoor screening with friends. DCR lists the Friday Esplanade screenings as part of its free family-flicks program.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor, captioned movie screening beside the Charles River.
cards.evidence_claim: DCR lists its 2026 Free Family Flicks at the Hatch Memorial Shell on Fridays and says screenings are open to the public and close captioned.
cards.source_title: DCR Movies in the Parks | Mass.gov
cards.access_notes: The official schedule lists Friday screenings at the Hatch Memorial Shell through August 21, 2026; films begin at sundown.

cards.entity_name: DCR Free Family Flicks at Castle Island
cards.title: Catch a Castle Island movie night
cards.subtitle: Castle Island, South Boston
cards.notes: Make a simple evening outing around the scheduled outdoor film and arrive before sundown. DCR lists these Wednesday screenings as open to the public and close captioned.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost outdoor movie night at Castle Island.
cards.evidence_claim: DCR lists 2026 Free Family Flicks at Castle Island on Wednesdays and says its screenings are open to the public and close captioned.
cards.source_title: DCR Movies in the Parks | Mass.gov
cards.access_notes: The official schedule lists Castle Island screenings on Wednesdays through August 26, 2026; films begin at sundown.

cards.title: Join a Greenway fitness class
cards.subtitle: Rose Kennedy Greenway, downtown Boston
cards.notes: Choose a listed class, wear comfortable clothes, and arrive ready to participate. The Greenway’s 2026 program offers more than 200 free yoga, HIIT, and dance-cardio classes.
cards.short_summary: Drop into a free outdoor movement class on the Greenway.
cards.evidence_claim: The Greenway’s 2026 program offers more than 200 free fitness classes, including yoga, HIIT, and dance cardio.
cards.source_title: May 2026: What’s Happening On & Around The Greenway
cards.access_notes: Times and locations vary; consult the Greenway calendar for the current class schedule.

cards.title: Get free face painting on the Greenway
cards.subtitle: Greenway Carousel area, downtown Boston
cards.notes: Stop by during the listed Friday or Saturday session for a playful group photo activity. The Greenway says FaceArt provides free face painting to all.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal, all-ages face-painting activity with no charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The Greenway states that FaceArt Face Painting provides free face painting to all during its listed Friday and Saturday sessions.
cards.source_title: Free FaceArt Face Painting | The Rose Kennedy Greenway
cards.access_notes: Listed Fridays run 11 a.m.–3 p.m. through September 4 and Saturdays 11 a.m.–6 p.m. through September 5, 2026.

cards.title: Walk the Emerald Necklace with a Park Ranger
cards.subtitle: Boston Common Visitor Center to Franklin Park
cards.notes: Join the scheduled Park Ranger-led route for a daylong, social walk through connected parks. Registration is not required, and the City lists the tour as free.
cards.short_summary: A guided walk across Boston’s linked park system.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston lists the September 20, 2026 Emerald Necklace Walking Tour as free, for ages 15+, with no registration required.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for September 20, 2026, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; meet outside the Boston Common Visitor Center. Bring water and comfortable shoes.
